profile.primary_concern: managing my chronic pain while on PrEP

context: As a woman living with chronic pain, I often feel overwhelmed by the prospect of starting PrEP. My condition affects my daily life significantly, and I worry about how the medication may interact with my pain management regimen. The stigma surrounding HIV prevention also adds to my anxiety, making me uncertain about discussing PrEP with healthcare professionals. I want to prioritize my health but fear the unknown impact on my well-being.
